title: Multiplying Quaternion with Vector3 result incorrect
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.4.1.rc2.official [abef5e0d2], v4.4.rc3.official [15ff45068], v4.4stable
- Not reproducible in v4.3.stable.official [77dcf97d8]

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.rc2 - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Single-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Intel(R) Arc(TM) A380 Graphics (Intel Corporation; 32.0.101.6079) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-8700K CPU @ 3.70GHz (12 threads)

### Issue description

I found this issue when porting an existing project to 4.4 caused glitches in some code related to rotation of vectors.
It appears as if the product of a Quaternion and Vector3 is incorrect. This happens in 4.4 and not in 4.3.

### Steps to reproduce

In the examples provided I used a value picked out because it produces inconsistent results with the previous version of Godot. Depending on the vectors used, the calculation could deviate more or less from the expected results.

```gdscript
	#(0.435174, 0.843702, -0.314309) og_a 
	#(0.753877, -0.150598, 0.639523) og_b
	#(0.435442, 0.843512, -0.31445) rot_a
	#(0.753816, -0.150717, 0.639567) rot_b
	var q = Quaternion(Vector3(0.435174, 0.843702, -0.314309), Vector3(0.435442, 0.843512, -0.31445))
	var res = q * Vector3(0.753877, -0.150598, 0.639523)
	print(res)
	 # res should be (0.753816, -0.150717, 0.639567)
	print((res - Vector3(0.753816, -0.150717, 0.639567)).length() < 0.00001)
```

Result in 4.4:
```
(0.753877, -0.150598, 0.639523)
false
```

Result in 4.3:
```
(0.753816, -0.150717, 0.639567)
true
```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[QuaternionBugExamples.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19411389/QuaternionBugExamples.zip)

This zip contains two projects. One for 4.3 and one for 4.4. They both have the same setup, same code, but produce different results.
